name: autonomous-website-audit
description: Page-by-page website audit and repair skill for Claude Code.

plugins.name: autonomous-website-audit
plugins.description: Audits and repairs a whole website, frontend and backend: architecture map of every page and component, duplicate and dead-code cleanup, backend endpoints matched to pages and benchmarked, a test account per role, phone/tablet/desktop in light and dark, then functionality and latency, design (every installed design skill), accessibility, security and i18n fixes page by page, with evidence gates and a findings ledger, until every page is done.
